publisher: NSW Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ) — Rent and Sales Report
rent_basis: Median weekly rent for NEW BONDS LODGED — new lettings, not the whole rented stock
dwelling_type_note: The two workbooks use different vocabularies — rents are House / Flat-Unit / Townhouse / Other, sales are Strata / Non Strata — and DCJ publishes no crosswalk between them. Pairing House with Non Strata would be an invention, so the distribution is computed on the one pairing the publisher itself defines on both sides.
suppression: Cells marked (s) — 30 or fewer bonds or properties — and '-' are excluded
method: gross yield = median weekly rent x 52 / (median sale price) x 100

platform_corpus_for_comparison.note: The corpus is the properties this platform has been asked to report on — selected investment stock rather than the market, which is one reason the two differ.
